title: Family climate action plan sheet
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y6 lesson 15 (Family climate action plan sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 15: Climate change: what can we do?. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Individuals
points: Waste less food; reuse and repair

blocks.title: Sort into: Mitigation / Adaptation
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Mitigation, Adaptation.
blocks.answer: Mitigation: solar panels; planting trees; cycling to school. Adaptation: flood barriers; drought-resistant crops; cooling centres in heatwaves

model.title: Which helps more: switching off a light or switching to renewable electricity?

parts.text: Light: a small saving each time
Renewable electricity: cuts emissions from all electricity used
Judgement: renewable switch is bigger, but both help

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Bigger system changes help most; small habits still matter

keywords.def: meeting our needs without harming the future
energy that will not run out, like wind and solar
reducing the causes of climate change
changing how we live to cope with climate change
the greenhouse gases our actions cause

questions.q: Is planting trees mitigation or adaptation?
questions.a: Mitigation: trees take in carbon dioxide

questions.q: Core: Make a family climate action plan with five actions, each labelled mitigation or adaptation and with a reason.
questions.a: Five sensible actions with labels and reasons

questions.q: Extend: Rank your actions from biggest to smallest effect.
Stretch: In the portal response box: 'Should countries or individuals do more?' Starter: 'I think ... because ...'

questions.a: B) Adaptation. It helps people cope with effects (floods), so it is adaptation.

questions.q: Big question: can one family make a difference?
questions.a: Yes: small actions add up and set an example, though big changes by countries matter most
